## About
Metropolitan Builders Roofing handles roofs, siding and windows for homes around Charlotte. We're part of Metropolitan Builders, a local builder and remodeler that also runs its own electrical division and custom woodworking shop.
The larger company has a custom showroom in historic Southend, where clients meet with the design and building team. When a roofing job ties into a bigger project at your home, the rest of the Metropolitan team is close by.
Neighbors have given us a 4.5 rating across 47 Google reviews. Give the office a call on a weekday and we'll talk through what your roof needs.

## Services
- Getting your roof replaced: We take your roof from the first inspection to the final cleanup. One reviewer said the crew showed up on time and finished as scheduled.
- Roof repairs and gutters: Repairs to existing roofs plus gutter work, including cleaning. One reviewer said David Tucker did a great job on both.
- Insurance roofing projects: Roof work connected to insurance claims, including hail damage. Ask us to walk you through each step before work begins.
- Siding and windows: Our division covers siding and windows along with roofing, so the outside of your home can be handled by one team.

## FAQ
Q: When is the office open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can Metropolitan help with other work on my home?
A: Yes. Metropolitan Builders takes on everything from full house remodels and custom homes to simple handyman chores.
